title: Summer Swells | The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art

meta.name: description
meta.content: Summer Swells gathers the pleasures of a beach day into bands of turquoise, white surf, and warm sand. Raised edges give the waves a physical presence, while passages of green and blue suggest water shifting as it approaches the shore. The composition holds the movement of the sea within a clear, open arrangement of color.

title: The Oceans | Vudi Phothisuk Art

meta.name: description
meta.content: The Oceans explores the sea through sculptural texture, shifting color, and personal memory. Shorelines, rolling waves, and imagined scales connect the pleasure of a beach day with curiosity about life beneath the surface. Across the collection, familiar coastal experiences open into questions of endurance, adventure, and responsibility. Each painting approaches the water differently, preserving both the intimacy of an individual encounter and the sense of a world extending beyond what we can see.
